envelope.description: Sam Okonjo picks up his phone and types a reply to Bristol Plumbing's text message to confirm the Thursday 8am slot, then presses send. The message is sent from his phone.
Sam Okonjo's confirmation text message is transmitted from his phone to the cellular network, heading toward Bristol Plumbing.

data.reason: The message has been sent; Sam may now put his phone down or wait for a reply.
